De dónde salen los documentos. Las carpe: Where the documents come from. Folders are referenced without copying the originals, wikis are read through their API and Git repositories by commit, all read-only; they are rescanned on their own: what is new or changed is indexed, what disappears is removed. The progress is in
La dirección para clonar por https. Sin: The address to clone over https. No user or password in it: for a private repository, use the token.
Para un repositorio privado. Se guarda c: For a private repository. It is stored encrypted, never shown again and only sent over https.
Solo si tu forja lo pide junto al token: Only if your forge asks for it along with the token (Bitbucket, Gitea). Otherwise leave it empty.
Una por línea, desde la raíz: «*» no cru: One per line, from the root: «*» does not cross folders and «**» does. Only documents come in (Markdown, text, HTML, PDF and office files). Hidden files and key files (.env, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa…) never do, and everything goes through the secret detector.
Una por línea. Al guardar un cambio se v: One per line. Saving a change reads the repository again: what is left out leaves the index.
Vacío = conservar el guardado. Si escrib: Empty = keep the stored one. If you write a new one, the connection is checked before saving.
Vacío = solo cuando pulses «Escanear». S: Empty = only when you press «Scan». With no new commits nothing is read.
